children.name: chromium
accessibility.spec.ts
Accessibility fixes (Feature 032)
hero search input does not carry aria-expanded (T3 — ARIA mismatch fix)
combobox container carries role=combobox and aria-haspopup=listbox (T3)
footer uses text-foreground/70 class, not text-muted-foreground (T1 — contrast fix)
offer card bank badge uses full color (no alpha reduction) (T2)
adsense.spec.ts
AdSense Integration (Feature 014)
page loads without AdSense errors by default (ADSENSE_ENABLED unset)
sidebar ad wrapper is hidden on mobile viewport (AC3)
sidebar ad wrapper is present in DOM on desktop viewport (AC3)
atlas-warmup-cron.spec.ts
Atlas Warmup — /api/health endpoint (Feature 012)
health endpoint returns expected JSON shape
health endpoint returns 200 with db status when DB is available
bundle-optimisation.spec.ts
Bundle Optimisation (Feature 033)
filter drawer opens and applies filters after dynamic load (T2)
search drawer opens and searches correctly after dynamic load (T3)
no JavaScript errors in browser console after dynamic components load (T4)
categories.spec.ts
Dynamic Category Filters (Feature 030)
AC7 — selecting a dynamic category chip sets ?category= URL param
AC7 — category filter round-trip: select → URL updates
AC8 — 'All' chip always present in FilterDrawer
AC8 — clicking 'All' clears the category filter
cold-start-performance.spec.ts
Cold-Start Performance (Feature 034)
FCP is below 1,500 ms with mocked API (AC4)
offer grid Suspense boundary renders skeleton or grid (T2)
full page load completes within 5 s with mocked API (T3 proxy)
dark-mode.spec.ts
Dark Mode (Feature 007)
dark class applied to html element when theme=dark
no FOUC — html has dark class before first paint
theme toggle button is visible in the header
filter-presets.spec.ts
Save Filter Presets (Feature 006)
save button visible when filters active, hidden when none (AC1)
saving a preset writes to localStorage and renders chip (AC2, AC3)
delete chip removes it from UI and localStorage (AC5)
chip click updates URL to preset filters (AC4)
interaction-timing.spec.ts
Interaction performance budgets (spec 029)
bank filter re-renders grid within 500 ms
category filter re-renders grid within 500 ms
clear all filters re-renders grid within 500 ms
pagination next-page re-renders grid within 500 ms
filter drawer opens and closes within 500 ms
lighthouse.spec.ts
Core Web Vitals — page load (Feature 031)
LCP is below 4 000 ms on home page (AC1)
FCP is below 3 000 ms on home page (AC2)
Search dropdown timing (Feature 031)
search dropdown appears within 1 500 ms of typing 2+ chars (AC3)
search dropdown hides within 500 ms after clearing input (AC3 — close)
mobile-performance-sla.spec.ts
Mobile Performance SLA — Feature 018
page has preconnect resource hint for logo CDN (AC5)
page has dns-prefetch hints for image CDNs (AC5)
offer grid renders within 10 s on simulated mobile (LCP proxy, AC3)
page has no horizontal overflow (CLS proxy, AC3)
page title is set (basic SEO / document readiness)
multi-select-filters.spec.ts
Multi-Select Filters (Feature 037)
T7 — selecting two banks and applying encodes both in the URL
AC8 — single bank=hnb param still filters correctly
AC5 — clicking All Banks in the drawer clears all bank selections from URL
offers.spec.ts
Offer Listing (Feature 001)
page loads and shows offer grid
filter by bank updates URL params
empty state shown when no offers match filter
hero section is visible on page load
filter section is visible on page load
expired offers not shown on initial load - no includeExpired param in default request
performance.spec.ts
Performance (Feature 004)
/api/ping responds without a 500 error (AC: warmup cron target)
/api/offers response includes _timing field (AC3: observability)
offer grid renders within 10 s (AC4: LCP proxy)
no horizontal scrollbar on load (layout stability proxy for CLS)
search-ux.spec.ts
Search UX Overhaul (Feature 017) > Typeahead (AC1, AC2)
search UX — typeahead works end to end (AC1, AC2)
Search UX Overhaul (Feature 017) > Scroll buttons (AC5, AC6)
scroll buttons appear and scroll correctly (AC5, AC6)
scroll-to-grid button has correct aria-label (AC5)
scroll-to-top button has correct aria-label (AC6)
Search UX Overhaul (Feature 017) > Partial-page refresh (AC4)
applying a filter keeps hero section mounted
search.spec.ts
Search — Hero bar
hero search input is visible on page load
typing and pressing Enter sets ?q= param
pressing Enter in hero input sets ?q= param
clear button appears after typing and clears ?q= on click
manually erasing input to empty clears ?q= from URL
visual.spec.ts
Visual regression
offer grid matches baseline
hero search bar matches baseline
empty state matches baseline
Structural sanity
critical data-testid elements are visible
pagination-controls renders when DB has multiple pages
